reason: Replace the automatic CTN influence-absorber recipe and its orthogonality-specific simulation assertions with ordinary native CTN/outcome composition. The existing score/quantile evaluator is moved from gam-predict/input.rs to gam-models/inference/predict_input.rs and re-exported, not deleted. The former issue-2139 materialization test is replaced by ctn_composition_requires_the_complete_fitted_model_service because a composed fit is no longer a single materialized request. reason: Historical acknowledgement for d2708daab (#2469): the Gamma shape MLE was bisected on a hand box [1e-8, 1e12] to a 1e-12 relative tolerance. ln(alpha) - psi(alpha) = target has exactly one root for a positive dispersion statistic, so it is bracketed by halving and doubling outward from the closed-form approximation and bisected until no representable midpoint remains; a statistic inside its own rounding band, a score inside its rounding band at the bracket, or a bracket leaving the representable range refuses.
